scope: Full-site Chinese/English page audit and bilingual UI completion

static_audit.policy: Every visible page must resolve request locale/current locale; only explicit redirects/aliases may omit page copy.

implementation: Neutral public pages now use getRequestLanguage instead of pinned English.
Auth, about/support/legal, dashboard/account, product install/privacy/support and root metadata have Chinese/English copy.
Product administration, version editing, upload and publication surfaces use current locale.
Legacy product-form component remains unmounted compatibility code; no route renders it.
Language switching on neutral routes refreshes in place and preserves route/query semantics.
limitations: Remote identity-provider pages are outside this application and are not translated here.
Product-authored content can intentionally contain Chinese or English independently; bilingual UI does not overwrite product content.
